# Comfy FLUX 3 Video- Text to Video

Generate full videos from a single text prompt with FLUX 3, which expands natural language into complete scenes with synchronized audio, no reference images or complex settings needed. Outputs 1 video in 720p at 24fps, 5 to 20 seconds long, supporting any aspect ratio from 9:16 to 21:9 with built-in sound design. Ideal for quick social media clips, ad mockups, and concept films requiring realistic motion and cinematic style. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_bfl_flux3_t2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.
